backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining types, event submission, and Callaway chart data with logic to store events and compute results.
feature_evidence.json: Evidence record describing a feature request to update Callaway chart column adjustments and listing affected files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-style reference file containing prewritten summaries for many frontend source files.
frontend/docs/callaway-chart-defaults.md: Developer doc explaining default Callaway chart structures, placeholder cells, and column adjustments.
frontend/DRAFT_RESTORED.md: Notes documenting restoration of a draft editing session without functional changes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global CSS defining light/dark theme variables and base styling tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell loading the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring routing, scoring flow steps, event setup, score entry, and results display.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component showing attribution, external link, and current year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header with title, navigation buttons, and admin/settings access controls.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminView.ts: Admin screen gating access via admin setting and rendering the Callaway chart editor when enabled.
frontend/src/features/admin/CallawayChar: UI for modifying Callaway grid charts, handling validation, edits, save, and reset for 9- and 18‑hole configurations.
frontend/src/features/eventSetup/EventSe: Form for configuring tournament settings including title, course, golfer count, hole count, and par, with validation and submit callback.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Breakd: Displays a golfer’s Callaway breakdown including gross, deductions, adjustments, net, and hole-by-hole scores.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Callaw: Shows the active Callaway scoring chart as a table for the selected hole count.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/export: Generates a print‑optimized HTML view in a new window to export tournament standings to PDF.
frontend/src/features/leaderboard/Leader: Renders ranked Callaway results with icons and formatted scoring details.
Computes Callaway results, renders standings, detailed breakdowns, chart, and supports PDF export.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/GolferS: Renders a list of golfer score entry cards with name and per‑hole score inputs, updating parent state on changes and calculating gross totals.
frontend/src/features/scoreEntry/validat: Validates golfer data by checking name, hole count, and ensuring each hole score is a positive number within limits.
frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsV: Displays settings UI including an admin access toggle tied to stored state and a back button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating related queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAccessEnabled: Provides reactive admin-access state synced via localStorage and custom events.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity authentication context, including login, logout, state management, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend queries for fetching the latest event result and Callaway chart using React Query and actor state.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global styles, fonts, Tailwind layers, and custom light/dark theme variables with a golf‑themed palette.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callaway.ts: Implements Callaway scoring logic, including chart lookup, worst‑hole deduction calculation, and net score computation.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartP: Manages saving, loading, and resetting Callaway grid charts in localStorage, including migration handling and default chart retrieval.
frontend/src/lib/callaway/gridPlaceholde: Provides helpers to detect placeholder grid cells and to parse or display cell values appropriately.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity context providers.
frontend/src/state/adminAccess.ts: Handles enabling and persisting admin access state via localStorage with a change event.
frontend/src/state/eventTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for event setup, golfer data, and Callaway result records.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS with custom colors, typography, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing features, requests, and state versioning for the Callaway Scoring app.
